note: generic bots ship as working scripts; app bots ship as a spec + skeleton the agent completes against THIS app's data model (they cannot be generic without lying).

bots.title: Site + server watchdog
bots.why: you hear about downtime, an expiring certificate, a full disk, an unhealthy container or a stale backup before a customer does

bots.title: Broken links + SEO basics
bots.why: a weekly crawl catches 404s, missing titles/descriptions, a missing sitemap.xml or robots.txt — the things that quietly cost traffic

bots.title: Backup proof (restore-grade evidence)
bots.why: a backup is only real if its newest copy exists in every target — this checks both buckets daily

bots.title: Dependency security audit
bots.why: weekly npm audit (high/critical) so a vulnerable package never sits unnoticed

bots.title: Weekly numbers in one message
bots.why: visits, sign-ups, orders/bookings and revenue for the week, compared with last week — the owner reads one message, not a dashboard
bots.spec: Query the app's own tables for the last 7 days vs the previous 7: new users, orders/bookings/leads, revenue if payments exist. One message via notify.py. Read-only DB user.

bots.title: Daily new-leads digest
bots.why: every enquiry/booking/quote request since yesterday, with contact details, in one morning message — nobody forgets to call back
bots.spec: Select form submissions / bookings / quote requests created since the last run (state file). Message: name, what they want, contact, link to the admin view.

bots.title: Finish-your-setup nudge
bots.why: users who signed up but never completed onboarding get one helpful email after 24h — the cheapest activation win in SaaS
bots.spec: Users created 24-48h ago with onboarding incomplete and no nudge sent: send ONE email (transactional provider), record it. Never twice.

bots.title: Failed-payment follow-up
bots.why: a failed card is usually recoverable — a polite email with the billing link saves the subscription
bots.spec: Subscriptions in past_due (payment provider API or webhook table): email the billing-portal link once per invoice; notify the owner of the total at risk.

bots.title: Appointment reminders
bots.why: an automatic reminder 24h and 2h before an appointment cuts no-shows
bots.spec: Bookings starting in 24h±30min and 2h±30min without the matching reminder flag: send, set the flag. Idempotent.

bots.title: Review request after service
bots.why: a happy customer asked the same day leaves a review — reviews are the local-search ranking factor you control
bots.spec: Orders/bookings completed today: one email with the review link (Google Business Profile URL from the profile). Opt-out respected.

bots.title: Low-stock alert
bots.why: products under their reorder threshold are listed every morning before they sell out
bots.spec: Products with stock <= threshold: one message listing them with current stock.
